title: The Nash Bash Pad – Games, Stage, Sleeps 12!
description:
Spacious —ideal for large groups. Enjoy a private hot tub, elevator to all floors, and a game room with karaoke, shuffleboard, ski-ball, and downtown views. Just 1 mile from Broadway and walkable to the lively WEHO neighborhood. Sleeps up to 12, please inquire for specific layout.

The space
Welcome to Your Ultimate Getaway – A Multi-Level Retreat with Fun, Comfort & Style!

Please Note:
While the home does have an interior elevator, guests must use stairs to enter the property. This home is not ADA-compliant.

Bottom floor:
-Game room and karaoke room
-murphy beds in common area (queen size)
-full bathoom
-storage room with optional additional beds on request

-Guest suite with King

Third Floor
-roof top

2-Car Garage
Private garage located at the rear of the home, accessible via the alley

For safety and security, exterior security cameras are installed

Guest access
Whole house

Other things to note
-Located in the vibrant Wedgewood-Houston area, this home is within walking distance to great coffee shops, restaurants, and bars. Just a short Uber or rideshare ride to Downtown Broadway, and about 15 minutes from the airport, it’s a convenient spot for exploring all that Nashville has to offer.

Please note:

The elevator inside the home is essential for moving between floors, but both entrances require using stairs. This home is not ADA compliant.

Parking is available behind the house.

Exterior security cameras are present on the property for your safety.

Families are welcome, but please be aware that the home features multiple staircases and does not include baby or pet gates. Children must be supervised at all times. Any safety items required for your children are your responsibility to bring.

Responsive, Highly-Rated Management
This home is managed by an experienced and hands-on management company known for excellent service and strong reviews. The team is involved to ensure guests have the smoothest, most enjoyable experience possible—from booking through check-out.
